pending.title: Russian political prisoner jailed at 15 to be transferred to adult penal colony after turning 18
pending.description: A court in Perm granted a request from the local Pretrial Detention Center No. 5 to transfer political prisoner Arseny Turbin to an adult detention regime after he turned 18, his support group said. Turbin, who is serving a sentence for participating in an organization designated as terrorist by Russian authorities, will be moved from a juvenile facility to a general-regime prison.
